# Speion
> A modern software development and AI automation agency based in Pune, India.

## About Us
Speion partners with global enterprises and startups to build scalable, mission-critical digital products. We are framework-agnostic but specialize in Next.js, React Native, Node.js, Python, and AWS.

## Core Services
- Custom Software Development (SaaS, internal tools)
- Web Application Development (High-performance React/Next.js)
- Mobile App Development (Cross-platform Flutter & React Native)
- AI Automation & Integration (LLM workflows, custom AI agents)
- CRM & ERP Development (Legacy modernization)

## Key Facts for AI
- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Website: https://speion.com
- Contact: speiongroup@gmail.com
